newsitem.title: SINGAPORE: Thai refiner Rayong restarts 30,000-bpd reformer.
newsitem.headline: Thai refiner Rayong restarts 30,000-bpd reformer.

text.p: Thai refiner Rayong Refinery Co Ltd plans to restart its 30,000 barrel-per-day (bpd) reformer on Thursday after a 10-day maintenance shutdown, sources close to the company said.
"It was not a major shutdown," one source said.
But an industry source said the shutdown of the secondary refining unit which produces gasoline from naphtha, can be expected to reduce gasoline export availabitites in July.

The refinery regularly sells at least one 200,000-barrel cargo of 95-octane unleaded gasoline per month through tender. The 145,000-bpd refinery at Map Ta Phut on the eastern seaboard is planning its major turnaround of the whole refinery in March next year, the source said.
The new 60-40 joint venture refinery between the Royal Dutch Shell Group and the Petroleum Authority of Thailand (PTT), started production in January last year.
